content.text:
D2 audit result: the first priority code gap is OS-backed OAuth credential storage. Desktop currently routes credentials into generic provider-key storage, not an Electron-owned secret vault. The smallest viable fix is a validated `safeStorage` credential bridge in main/preload, used only by OAuth save/load/delete, with focused vault and OAuth bridge tests.

Next: desktop lacks an actual OAuth callback/deep-link receiver; Codex’s loopback callback is configured but no listener is present. Screen capture is intentionally denied pending a learner-visible picker.

Runtime-only gates still needed: real mic/camera, chosen screen source, OAuth return, course WebSocket, clean outside-checkout install, and 1024/1440 visual comparison. I made no changes or ran tests.
